role: One post-open Case 19 frame-zero mechanism gate for a deterministic deployment-visible camera-weighted measurement-Krylov-complement linear-heat correction. It is not a prospective external confirmation, camera selection, camera identity model, top-k repair, component/frequency repair, learned predictor, threshold search, or resource result.
scientific_question: Can a camera-permutation-equivariant residual-to-observation energy metric reweight the complete K13 measurement projection strongly enough to remove the camera-local observation mismatch found by v259 while preserving the field and gradient repair of v258, followed by one unchanged full-field PCGLS step and fewer exact calls than K16?
physical_hypothesis: The v259 excess is concentrated by camera because the unweighted K13 projection treats camera blocks with different normalized unexplained energy equally. Weighting each camera block by its deployment-visible K13 residual energy divided by its observation energy changes only the measurement metric used to remove the already fitted K13 span; it does not select cameras, alter the heat map, add directions, or read truth.
design_evidence_boundary: Case 19 and v244-v259 are already open and motivate this single post-open camera-local diagnostic. No v260 Case 19 field, camera score, camera weight, weighted coefficient, residual, metric, pass count or gate value may be computed before this protocol, core, runner, independent validator and tests are committed. Synthetic unit tests do not read Case 19.

frozen_data_and_geometry.camera_roster: For each rig use the first nine stable IDs in the v209 order, then sort IDs in ascending ASCII order before operator construction.
frozen_data_and_geometry.preprocessing: Reuse the exact v248 frame-zero parser, float64 rectilinear interpolation, one-voxel truth support and active-cell truth gauge.
frozen_data_and_geometry.truth_use: CFD truth generates the synthetic observation and scores four veto metrics only. It never enters K13, camera scores, camera weights, heat diffusion, weighted complement, controls, depth or stopping.

unique_primary.name: canonical_camera_zero_geometry_jacobi_pcgls_k13_residual_energy_camera_weighted_linear_heat_measurement_krylov_complement_restart_pcgls_k1
unique_primary.base: Run zero-start reported-geometry diagonal-Jacobi PCGLS K13 and retain all thirteen field search directions p_i and exact projected directions A p_i in iteration order.
unique_primary.camera_score: For each active camera c, s_c = ||r13_c||_2^2 / max(||y_c||_2^2, float64_tiny), where each block contains both detector components and all 16x16 pixels. Define positive_c=max(s_c,float64_tiny) and w_c=positive_c/mean(positive). No clipping, exponent, rank, threshold, camera identity, top-k, fallback or learned parameter is used.
unique_primary.raw_heat_correction: Apply the frozen v250 linear six-neighbour heat map to x13: 16,604 active-active edges, simultaneous explicit flux, tau=1/12, twelve steps, one-voxel zero support and active-cell mean gauge. Set d=heat(x13)-x13 and compute exactly one A d.
unique_primary.weighted_complete_normal_projection: Let P=[p_i], Q=[A p_i], and W repeat w_c over every pixel and component of camera c. Form G=Q^T W Q and b=Q^T W A d. Scale G to its unit-diagonal correlation matrix and use a complete float64 symmetric eigensolve. If min_eigenvalue <= 1e-12*max_eigenvalue, execution is invalid. With no rank truncation, ridge, pseudoinverse or coefficient clipping, solve G beta=b and set d_perp=d-P beta and A d_perp=A d-Q beta.
unique_primary.warm_initializer: Set x_warm=x13+d_perp and use the cached projection y-r13+A d_perp. Then run exactly one unchanged full-field reported-geometry diagonal-Jacobi PCGLS iteration. No fallback or early stopping.
unique_primary.ledger: K13 costs 13A+13A^T; A d costs 1A; cached-projection restarted PCGLS K1 costs 1A+1A^T. Camera weights and weighted Gram algebra add 0A+0A^T.

forbidden_search: No score formula, normalization, camera identity, top-k, camera subset, score exponent, score clipping, floor beyond float64 tiny, threshold, rank, eigensolver floor, ridge, pseudoinverse, direction weighting, heat graph, boundary, step count/size, blend, correction multiplier, depth, preconditioner, rig, metric, tolerance or fallback search is allowed after freeze. accuracy_gate.two_replica_envelope: For every arm, rig and metric take max(formal_metric, independent_metric) before any absolute, matched, tail or control decision. Passing therefore requires both numerical implementations to pass every gate.
accuracy_gate.control_dominance: If the equal-call unweighted v258 complement, equal-call frozen linear-heat control, or cheaper K14 control passes all thirteen absolute and K16-matched envelope cells, camera-weighting-specific headroom is not isolated.

independent_validation.method: A second program must rebuild observations and Jacobi, independently implement the K13 recurrence, scalar-loop heat map, per-camera score and mean-one weights, weighted correlation system using a separate Cholesky solve, cached-projection restart, all four controls, physical replay, metrics and calls without importing the formal v260 core or runner. It seals predictions before reading formal scientific arrays.
independent_validation.adjudication: Continuous cross-implementation differences are reported and bounded, but the scientific decision uses the componentwise worst-case metric envelope rather than exact floating equality.

decision_order: Any source, parent, input, shape, finite, full-rank, camera-weight, heat, weighted-normal-equation, weighted-orthogonality, projection-reconstruction, permutation, call-ledger, replay, seal or prospective cross-implementation closure failure gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE19_CAMERA_WEIGHTED_COMPLEMENT_FRAME_ZERO_V260.

If the unique primary fails any of the thirteen absolute or K16-matched worst-case-envelope cells, conclude FAIL_CASE19_CAMERA_WEIGHTED_COMPLEMENT_FRAME_ZERO_V260 and close this residual-energy camera-weighted complement mechanism without a full sequence run.

If the primary passes all thirteen but the unweighted v258 complement, equal-call linear-heat, or cheaper K14 control also passes all thirteen envelope cells, conclude PASS_CASE19_FRAME_ZERO_BUT_CAMERA_WEIGHTED_ADVANTAGE_NOT_ISOLATED_V260.

Only if the primary passes 13/13 absolute and matched envelope cells, all three same-or-lower-cost controls remain incomplete, every ledger and independent check passes may conclude POST_OPEN_CASE19_CAMERA_WEIGHTED_COMPLEMENT_FRAME_ZERO_HEADROOM_V260 and authorize one separately frozen 429-cell sequence gate.
failure_action: Close the residual-energy camera-weighted K13 measurement-complement correction without changing the score, weight transform, rank, eigensolver, heat map, depths, controls or thresholds. Do not rescue with per-rig camera selection, component/frequency weights, endpoint blending, CNN, FNO, UNO, DeepONet or GPU.
